page.layout: Running head at top centre. Two columns of index entries, left and right, with bare letter headings (L, M, N, O, P, Q, R) inside the columns. No page number printed. The left column continues into the right column at "1. 11.".

main_text.l: Iis per quos agere possumus Tit.10.lib.4.166.

Rerum diuisione, & adquiren-do earum dominio Tit. 1.lib.2.31.

page.notes: The first left-column entry "de Patri[?]æ potestate" is doubtful at the letter after "Patri". The entry "Patria potestate Tit.9.lib." on the left is completed by "1. 11." at the top of the right column. The "di&." in "Publicis iudiciis" is the ct ligature, transcribed as "dict.". Keep the lines as printed; there is no page number.
